data.name: About_Neutral
data.value: Factory 6500K white: the white that the web, photos and Windows expect. The most accurate of the built-in presets; recommended.

data.name: About_CustomRgb
data.value: You set the white with RGB gain; the setup wizard matches the white to the Pixel's screen here. The most accurate choice after the wizard. The blue light filter uses the monitor's gains only in this preset.

data.name: About_Warm
data.value: Warm white (about 5000K): yellowish. Comfortable for reading in the evening; not for color accuracy.

data.name: About_Cool
data.value: Cool white (about 9300K): bluish. Not accurate and more tiring for the eyes.

data.name: About_Native
data.value: The panel's unprocessed white (no color correction): the brightest preset, but the white is usually bluish.

data.name: About_HpEnhancePlus
data.value: HP's vivid mode: raises sharpness and contrast. Looks vivid in video; can add halos to text and clip light tones.

data.name: About_LowBlueLight
data.value: HP's low blue light mode (TÜV certified): less blue, warmer colors. For eye comfort.

data.name: About_Reading
data.value: HP's reading mode: balances blue light and brightness for reading indoors.

data.name: About_Night
data.value: HP's night mode: blue light at its lowest. For the hours before sleep.

data.name: About_Unverified
data.value: The DDC number of this preset is estimated: after choosing it, check its name in the monitor menu under Information → Color Setting.

data.name: Hint_Sharpness
data.value: Factory value is 4. Higher values add thin light/dark halos around text; if you see them, lower it. The setup wizard's sharpness step finds the best value with a pattern.

data.name: Lock_NotWritable
data.value: This setting cannot be written from the app; change it in the monitor menu.

data.name: Lock_WrongColorPreset
data.value: RGB gain only works in the Custom RGB color preset. Choose Custom RGB in the Color preset list above or in the monitor menu (Color).

data.name: Lock_BlueLightActive
data.value: The blue light filter is on and uses the monitor's color gains. Turn the filter off to change RGB gain or the color preset; your value comes back.

data.name: Lock_DimmingActive
data.value: Extra (digital) dimming is on; the backlight is controlled by the brightness and extra dimming slider. Adjust it there.

data.name: Result_Written
data.value: Setting written.

data.name: Result_Unchanged
data.value: The value is already set.

data.name: Result_NoDdc
data.value: The monitor does not answer DDC/CI.

data.name: Result_NotSupported
data.value: This setting does not exist on this monitor or writing it is not allowed.

data.name: Result_Locked
data.value: This setting cannot be changed right now (the reason is shown under it).

data.name: Result_OutOfRange
data.value: The value is outside the allowed range.

data.name: Result_BlockedDigitalBoost
data.value: Contrast is not raised above its starting value. For a brighter picture, raise the backlight (Brightness).

data.name: Result_NotApplied
data.value: The monitor did not accept this preset over DDC and stayed on the old one. Choose this preset in the monitor menu (Color).

data.name: Result_ExternallyChanged
data.value: This setting changed on the monitor (OSD) while you were looking. The new value is shown; set it again if you still want to.

data.name: Result_NeedsInputWarning
data.value: The input change is waiting for confirmation.

data.name: Result_Throttled
data.value: The same setting was written too often; wait a moment to protect the monitor's memory.

data.name: Result_Failed
data.value: The monitor did not accept the setting.

data.name: ExternalChange
data.value: Changed on the monitor (OSD): {0}. The new values are shown; your value was not overwritten.

data.name: InputWarning_Title
data.value: Change input?

data.name: InputWarning_Text
data.value: If you switch to an input other than the one the cable is connected to, the screen may go blank. To come back, choose HDMI with the monitor's Input button. Continue?

data.name: Osd_Title
data.value: The monitor does not answer DDC/CI

data.name: Osd_Why
data.value: The app cannot change these settings; use the monitor's own menu. First check that Management → DDC/CI is on in the menu, then press "Read again from monitor" on this page.

data.name: Osd_Brightness
data.value: Brightness and contrast: Brightness+ menu. To make the picture brighter, raise only Brightness.

data.name: Osd_Color
data.value: Color: Color menu. Keep the default Neutral; choose Custom RGB for RGB gain.

data.name: Osd_Image
data.value: Sharpness: Image → Sharpness (factory Level 4). Keep Image Scaling at "Fill to Screen" and Overscan "Off".

data.name: Osd_Input
data.value: Input: HDMI in the Input menu.

data.name: Osd_Volume
data.value: Speaker volume: in the monitor menu or in the Windows sound settings.
